subject: Duplicate data ingestion spike — credit allocation & VAT handling
messages:
From: Derek Lang <derek.lang@heliumhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Helium Health Billing <billing@heliumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice - possible duplicate ingestion

Hi Alex,

We're reviewing our January invoice (INV-2026-01) and seeing a large usage spike tied to the data connector ingestion that looks like duplicate events were counted for ~72 hours. Attached is a CSV extract from our side showing duplicated payload hashes. The net overcharge is roughly $12.48k before tax.

Can Redwood confirm whether a connector retry loop produced duplicate tokens on your end? We need to reconcile quickly — our procurement team is asking whether you can issue a credit memo or apply a balance to our next invoice. Also need to confirm how VAT will be handled for the credit.

I've attached the usage extract and our invoice PDF for reference.

Thanks,
Derek Lang
Head of Data Integrations
Helium Health

Attachments: usage_export_helium_20260131.csv (csv), invoice_INV-2026-01-HELIUM.pdf (pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Derek Lang <derek.lang@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice - possible duplicate ingestion

Thanks for the note and the attachments, Derek — and sorry for the disruption. I pulled finance and ops in so we can resolve this quickly.

Sean, can you confirm whether the connector experienced any duplicate-request retries for Helium Health between 2026-01-12 and 2026-01-15? Laura — finance, please hold off on issuing anything until we agree the numbers, but please be ready with credit memo templates and VAT handling options.

Proposed next steps (quick):
- Sean to confirm root cause and provide a short engineer summary of the duplicate ingestion window and token counts.
- Laura to prepare two paths: (A) issue a credit memo for full net amount and a separate VAT adjustment, or (B) apply a balance to the next invoice and issue supporting tax paperwork.
- We'll need Helium's VAT registration (if applicable) to issue a VAT-corrected credit memo.

Derek — would you prefer the credit applied to your next invoice, or a standalone credit memo for accounting? Either works for us, just let us know.

I'll follow up once Sean confirms the ingestion logs.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Derek Lang <derek.lang@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice - possible duplicate ingestion

Hi all,

I reviewed the initial numbers Alex sent after Sean's engineer notes (see below) — confirm we have an eligible overcharge here. Summary:
- Duplicate tokens counted: 1,560 tokens (approx).
- Net overbilled amount (USD, pre-tax): $12,480.00.
- VAT charged on original invoice was $1,872.00 (15% local VAT applied by Helium's billing settings).

Options to remediate:
1) Credit memo: Issue a standalone credit memo for $12,480.00 (net) + a VAT correction of $1,872.00. To produce the VAT-corrected credit we need Helium's VAT registration number and confirmation of the invoicing entity to match tax records. We will produce one credit memo referencing INV-2026-01 and a VAT note.
2) Apply credit to next invoice: Place a $12,480.00 service credit on the February invoice and issue a separate VAT adjustment record for Helium to reconcile locally. This avoids creating a negative invoice, but some customers prefer a formal credit memo.

Recommended: Issue a credit memo (option 1) so Helium has documentation for audit trails. If Helium prefers option 2, we can do that as well.

If you choose option 1, please provide:
- Company legal name exactly as on tax registration
- VAT registration number (or confirmation that Helium is not VAT-registered)
- Preferred credit memo recipient email (billing@heliumhealth.com is fine)

Once we have confirmation I will generate the credit memo and the VAT adjustment. Estimated processing time: 3 business days after we receive VAT proof and signoff.

Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
Finance — Billing Operations

Attachments referenced: internal_usage_recon_helium_202601 (internal)

From: Derek Lang <derek.lang@heliumhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike on Jan invoice - possible duplicate ingestion

Hi Laura, Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Helium is fine with a standalone credit memo (option 1). Our details below:

Company legal name: Helium Health Ltd.
VAT registration number: GB99887766 (UK VAT)
Preferred recipient: billing@heliumhealth.com
Please reference invoice INV-2026-01 and apply the credit against that invoice.

We confirm the net overcharge calculation and accept the VAT correction you outlined. If you can issue the credit memo and the VAT note by EOD Tuesday (2026-02-24), that would let our accounting close the month.

Appreciate the team's help here — and Sean, please let us know the root cause summary for our engineering postmortem.

Best,
Derek
Head of Data Integrations
Helium Health

Forwarded message:
From: sean.gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: [EXTERNAL] Connector retry loop analysis (Helium Health)
To: alex.martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

(Engineer summary) Between 2026-01-12T03:10 and 2026-01-15T07:42 UTC a connector backoff misconfiguration caused three parallel retry streams for a subset of payloads. The runtime double- and triple-counted kv-store inserts when the idempotency key was not present on retries. We've patched the connector and issued a runtime mitigation. Estimated duplicate token window aligns with Helium's CSV.

Sean Gallagher
Sr. Infra Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
